subject: Does anyone have any examples of a Shiny app using DataTables child rows feature?

messages.author: c5c30f6fbd1db8aa
messages.subject: Does anyone have any examples of a Shiny app using DataTables child rows feature?
parts:
Hello,
I saw on the Shiny github mentioning that the upgraded version of DataTables in Shiny has support for Child Rows like (https://datatables.net/examples/api/row_details.html) This is exactly what I need in my app, but have no idea how to implement this in Shiny.  Does anyone know of or have an example on how to use this?

Thanks,
Brian
